Delivery outcome is classified from the sink's resolved value (statusCode + retry-after / x-sentry-rate-limits headers) rather than from promise settlement; durability comes from claim-then-remove-after-ack; identity preservation comes from parsing the stamps the scrub layer wrote and scrubbing on read with the recovered identity instead of the current one.

implement.summary: Defects on BASE_SHA f250acd7: apps/mobile/src/diagnostics/retention.ts does not exist and sentry.ts:156-161 builds createScrubbedTransport(makeTransport(options)) with no persistence — an envelope the JS-only transport cannot deliver is lost, so the W10-02 objective (bounded on-disk buffer with size/age caps, deterministic eviction, corruption tolerance, never blocking the UI thread) is unmet as behaviour; getDiagnosticsStatus() hard-codes persistentQueue:false (sentry.ts:315). The r1 candidate (614ab65f) added retention but (a) retention.ts:513 treated any RESOLVED sink.send() as delivery, while @sentry/core's fetch transport resolves {statusCode:429/503} and then drops locally under its own rate limit, so a 429+Retry-After or a 5xx outage drained and discarded the whole buffer; (b) online 5xx answers were never stored; (c) decodeEnvelope() (retention.ts:171-183) re-scrubbed stored payloads with the CURRENT identity so after an app update build N crashes were attributed to build N+1. Round 2 (from BASE, reusing the sound r1 store/SQLite/scheduling design): test commit d2b2b372 adds apps/mobile/src/diagnostics/__tests__/retention.test.ts (54 tests, fails on BASE: module missing); impl commit 08eb551b adds retention.ts — classifyDiagnosticDelivery() accepts only 2xx, treats 429 as an answered retry honouring Retry-After (seconds/HTTP-date) or X-Sentry-Rate-Limits with a 60 s default, 408/5xx as answered retries, other 4xx as terminal refusals (dropped, not retried forever), statusless results as unanswered retries; the drain peek()s the oldest row and remove()s it only after acknowledgement (in-flight sequences skipped so a hung request does not pin later envelopes); retry windows are clock-based so no probe happens before Retry-After/capped backoff (5 s..1 h) elapses; online sends refused with a retryable status are stored like network failures; retainedDiagnosticIdentity() recovers release/dist/environment/source_revision/model_version/policy_version from the stamped event and decodeEnvelope() re-scrubs with THAT identity (only sent_at is refreshed to send time); byte cap is measured against length(CAST(payload AS BLOB)) on disk; sequences are monotonic within a process even after the table empties. sentry.ts wires retention behind the scrub layer in the shipping init path. VERIFIED: AC1 160/160, AC2 exit 0, AC3 exit 0, pnpm format:check exit 0, git diff --check exit 0; r1 adversary suite against HEAD: A1/A2a/A2b/A3/A6/A8/A10 pass (https://la-hacks-rttothemoon.devinenterprise.com/attachments/921d55f0-76d3-4265-ad8b-9bbefca79ad3/r1-adversary-suite-on-head.log). planDiagnosticRetention uses Math.abs(now - storedAt) <= maxAgeMs, so rows stamped more than 7 days in the FUTURE (device clock jumped backwards after storing) are evicted as 'expired' rather than kept; deterministic and bounded, and arguably the safer choice, but worth documenting.
review.summary: Independent re-verification of W10-02 candidate devin/pp/w10-02/impl-r2 @ 08eb551b (BASE f250acd7). SCOPE: `git diff --stat` shows exactly 3 files — retention.ts (+880, write_path), __tests__/retention.test.ts (+1856, write_path), sentry.ts (+18/-4). sentry.ts is the declared out_of_scope wiring file; it is not under any serial_group_paths prefix, and the edit is minimal (optional `retain?: (sink) => DiagnosticTransport` on optionsForDiagnostics, applied INSIDE createScrubbedTransport so only scrubbed envelopes are ever persisted; initializeSdk builds createDiagnosticRetention(identity) and passes retain; getDiagnosticsStatus().persistentQueue reports it). No existing comments modified, no test edits outside the new file. scope_violation=false. SHIPPED BEHAVIOUR (1b): the module is called from the shipping init path (initializeSdk) — VERIFIED by reading; the retention only activates when the existing gate reaches ready_js_only, and the gate/runtimeConfig/DSN are untouched (sentry.test.ts still pins transportEnabled:false, dsn:null, persistentQueue:false in the shipped config), so 'diagnostics transport stays disabled' holds. Extra: full apps/mobile jest exit 0 (313 suites, 6108 tests, 1 pre-existing gated skip unrelated to the candidate). CODE REVIEW vs REVIEW.md/objective: hard caps enforced in planDiagnosticRetention (maxEnvelopes 32, maxTotalBytes 256 KiB measured as length(CAST(payload AS BLOB)) on disk, maxEnvelopeBytes 32 KiB, maxAge 7 d) with deterministic oldest-first (sequence-ordered) eviction after dropping invalid/oversize/expired rows; corruption tolerance = per-row JSON/shape validation with removal, schema/table reset on read failure, and inert degradation when the SQLite module cannot load (send() still resolves, flush() resolves). UI thread: every store op is chained on a promise queue and awaits op-sqlite async APIs; nothing synchronous touches disk; retries are timer-driven with clock-based windows (5 s..1 h backoff, 429 honours Retry-After / X-Sentry-Rate-Limits, default 60 s). Delivery classification accepts only 2xx; 408/429/5xx/statusless retain; other 4xx are terminal (not retried forever) — so a partial/failed/replayed delivery never counts as success and corrupt rows never become fabricated state. Durability is claim-then-remove-after-ack with in-flight sequence tracking so a hung request does not pin later envelopes. Privacy: only scrubDiagnosticEnvelope() output is persisted; on replay the producing identity (release/dist/environment/source_revision/model_version/policy_version) is recovered from the stamped event and re-scrubbed with THAT identity (only sent_at refreshed), with tests pinning no marker leaks and no attribution to the current build after an update. No RLS/grants/migrations/billing/session/auth/copy surfaces touched. Grepped the diff for test-weakening constructs (.skip/.only/@ts-ignore/any/eslint-disable/passWithNoTests/forceExit/inflated timeouts): none. VERDICT: approve.
